rows.behavior: The okf add argument matches a scaccogatto settings entry: repo[#ref] for github, url[#ref] for git, url for url, path for directory, and scaccogatto/okf-skills when no entry exists.
rows.fails_when: for any kind, with or without a ref, the argument kmctl passes to marketplace add is not the one listed, or with no entry it is not scaccogatto/okf-skills

rows.behavior: kmctl picks the entry claude compares against: managed-settings.json, then managed-settings.d/*.json sorted by name with dot-files skipped, the last one winning, and any managed entry over the user entry.
rows.fails_when: with entries in managed-settings.json and a managed-settings.d file, kmctl uses the earlier one; with two managed-settings.d files it uses the one that sorts first; it reads a dot-file; or with a managed and a user entry it uses the user one

rows.behavior: An entry no add argument can match (a github path, a url's headers or headersHelper, or an unknown kind) stops the install before claude runs, with a message naming the settings file.
rows.fails_when: such an entry does not raise PluginError, the message does not name the file, or claude is called

rows.behavior: With user settings that declare scaccogatto from a git URL, kmctl plugin install succeeds at project scope with okf installed, without editing the settings.
rows.fails_when: in an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME whose user settings declare scaccogatto from https://github.com/scaccogatto/okf-skills.git, kmctl plugin install exits nonzero, okf is not installed, or the user settings file changed

rows.behavior: When claude refuses the argument kmctl built from the entry (a git entry without .git), kmctl stops with a PluginError naming the settings file and the entry.
rows.fails_when: in an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME whose user settings declare scaccogatto as git from https://github.com/scaccogatto/okf-skills (no .git), kmctl plugin install exits 0, or its message does not name the settings file and the entry, or the settings file changed

rows.behavior: The other plugin install tests still pass.
rows.fails_when: any test in tests/test_plugin_install.py or tests/test_plugin.py fails
